system.description:
You take powdered foxglove petals and infuse medical chakra into them, before releasing them into a controlled cloud of delirium and nausea. Select a point you can see in range, as you fill a 10-foot cube, centered on this point with a cloud of hallucinogenic flower petals, forcing all creatures in range to make a Constitution saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature gains 1 rank of Envenomed and are Confused.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but they are also Berserked so long as they are Envenomed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of the jutsu by 3 and the range by +10 feet. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the size of the cube by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the size of the cube by +5 feet.
